layers.text: Recolour only two things: the bright light blue face becomes deep blue like the body, colour #205794 with #164271 shadows; and the blue field of the round neck frill becomes dark navy, colour #0f1a4a, so the face stands out in front of it. Do not redraw anything. Keep the frill's orange rim and its two orange eye-spots, the cream horns, beak, cheek and belly, the eyes, the body, legs, tail, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
